title: LLMs vs. Traditional Sentiment Tools in Psychology: An Evaluation on Belgian-Dutch Narratives
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the sentiment analysis capabilities (emotional valence) of LLMs compared to traditional lexicon tools in the context of psychological research.
